priorityList: Use Execution Sentence immediately before casting Wake of Ashes.
Use Avenging Wrath (or Crusade) on cooldown, ideally when Expurgation is ticking on the target.
Spend Holy Power if you are at 5 charges or if the Hammer of Light free proc is about to expire.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority finisher when available.
Cast Divine Storm as a finisher only if Empyrean Power is active.
Cast Templar's Verdict as your standard Holy Power finisher.
Cast Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or has more than 6 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Avenging Wrath.
Cast Hammer of Wrath as a high-priority generator if the Walk into Light talent is active.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Cast Hammer of Wrath to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and apply its debuff.
Cast Templar Strike, Templar Slash, or Crusader Strike as filler generators.
Use offensive trinkets and potions during Avenging Wrath or when Execution Sentence is active.
